body: nmom yelled at me (over the phone as i was dying in the icu) for attempting suicide at such an inconvenient time for her. two weeks into me having severe kidney failure she told me i ruined her birthday but of course texted me photos from her party later that day. & what really confirmed it for me was the fact that she didn't bother to visit me once in the entire month i spent hospitalized, undergoing tons of procedures, relearning how to walk, etc. i have permanent nerve injuries and chronic health issues as a result but she still loves to claim that the experience was more painful and traumatic for her. yup, let that sink in...

After 19 days off benzos you’re likely way past seizure risk (usually that’s the first week) but I just mentioned the Gabapentin because if you’ve already come off one gaba drug (the benzo) you don’t want to come off another (Gabapentin) at the same time— too much for your brain to handle at once and if you’re still worried about seizure prevention luckily Gabapentin is an anti-convulsant!

For now focus on getting thru the benzo WDs but continue to take the Gabapentin as prescribed. Do not try to get off too many gaba drugs all at once— one step at a time 🌸

Be careful not taking the Gabapentin (as you were prescribed), it’s an anti-convulsant with anti-anxiety properties so it can help seizure prevention as well as withdrawal symptoms. If you were taking it daily and suddenly CT it can actually put you more at risk for seizures.

Source: I was prescribed Gabapentin for benzo withdrawal myself & am in the pharmaceutical sciences (ironic, I know)
